Assessment.content: Low mood and depressive symptoms with decreased appetite, low energy, functional impact for approximately 3 months and associated weight loss
Assessment.source_text: 1. Low mood/depressive symptoms — decreased appetite, anergia, functional impact x ~3 months, weight loss.

Assessment.content: History of hypothyroidism, currently off thyroxine, considered a possible contributing endocrine cause
Assessment.source_text: 2. History of hypothyroidism, off thyroxine — possible contributing endocrine cause.

Assessment.content: Episodic palpitations with subjective dyspnea, situational and worse in lifts, with differential including anxiety-related palpitations versus thyroid-related tachyarrhythmia
Assessment.source_text: 3. Episodic palpitations with subjective dyspnea (situational; worse in lifts) — possible anxiety/palpitations vs thyroid-related tachyarrhythmia.

Assessment.content: Weight loss and nausea to be correlated with mood, thyroid status, and palpitations; need to rule out anemia and metabolic causes
Assessment.source_text: 4. Weight loss/nausea — correlate with 1–3; rule out anemia, metabolic causes.
